questions.stem:
Division of \(f(x)\) by \((x+1)(x-2)\) leaves remainder \(3x-1\).

(a) Find \(f(-1)\).

(b) Let \[\begin{gathered}g(x)=f(x)\\{}+ax^2+bx+2\end{gathered}\]. Its remainder on division by \(x+1\) is 8. Both \(f,g\) are divisible by \(2x-1\). Find \(a,b\).
questions.stemZh:
多項式 \(f(x)\) 被 \((x+1)(x-2)\) 除所得餘式為 \(3x-1\)。

(a) 求 \(f(-1)\)。

(b) 設 \[\begin{gathered}g(x)=f(x)\\{}+ax^2+bx+2\end{gathered}\]。它被 \(x+1\) 除所得餘式為 8。已知 \(f,g\) 皆可被 \(2x-1\) 整除，求 \(a,b\)。
questions.solution:
(a) Substitute −1 into the remainder to obtain −4.

(b) At −1 the difference \(g-f\) is 12, giving \(a-b=10\). At \(1/2\) both polynomials vanish, giving \(a+2b=-8\). Subtract to obtain \(3b=-18\), so \(b=-6\) and \(a=4\).
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/polynomials reviews3.pdf · 第4題

questions.stem:
A cubic \(f\) is divisible by \(x-2\). Its remainder on division by \(x^2-4\) is \(kx-18\).

(a) Find \(k\). (b) Also \(x+5\) divides \(f\), and division by \(x\) leaves remainder 30. Must all its roots be integers? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
三次式 \(f\) 可被 \(x-2\) 整除，被 \(x^2-4\) 除所得餘式為 \(kx-18\)。

(a) 求 \(k\)。(b) 已知 \(x+5\) 亦為因式，且被 \(x\) 除時餘式為 30。各根是否全為整數？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) At 2 the remainder vanishes, so \(2k=18\) and \(k=9\).

(b) Write \[\begin{gathered}f=(x-2)(x+5)\\{}\cdot (Ax+B)\end{gathered}\]. At zero, \(-10B=30\), so \(B=-3\). At −2 the remainder gives −36, so \(-12(-2A-3)=-36\). Hence \(A=-3\). The roots are 2, −5 and −1, all integers.
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/polynomials reviews3.pdf · 第5題

questions.stem:
A cubic \(g\) is divisible by \(x+1\). Division by \(x^2-1\) leaves remainder \(kx-5\).

(a) Find \(k\). (b) Also \(x-2\) divides \(g\) and division by \(15-5x\) leaves remainder 44. Are all roots rational? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
三次式 \(g\) 可被 \(x+1\) 整除，被 \(x^2-1\) 除所得餘式為 \(kx-5\)。

(a) 求 \(k\)。(b) 已知 \(x-2\) 亦為因式，且被 \(15-5x\) 除時餘式為 44。各根是否全為有理數？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) At −1, \(-k-5=0\), so \(k=-5\).

(b) Write \[\begin{gathered}g=(x+1)(x-2)\\{}\cdot (Ax+B)\end{gathered}\]. At 1, \(g(1)=-10\), so \(A+B=5\). At 3, \(g(3)=44\), so \(3A+B=11\). Thus \(A=3,B=2\). The roots −1, 2 and \(-2/3\) are rational.

questions.stem:
The polynomial \(f\) is divisible by \(x-3\). Division by \(x^2+1\) gives quotient \(3x^2-2x-23\) and remainder \(cx+29\).

(a) Find \(c\). (b) Prove that \(x+2\) divides \(f\). (c) Are all the roots of \(f(x)=0\) rational? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
多項式 \(f\) 可被 \(x-3\) 整除，被 \(x^2+1\) 除所得商式為 \(3x^2-2x-23\)，餘式為 \(cx+29\)。

(a) 求 \(c\)。(b) 證明 \(x+2\) 是因式。(c) 方程 \(f(x)=0\) 的根是否全為有理數？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) At 3 the division identity gives \(0=10(-2)+3c+29\), so \(c=-3\).

(b) At −2 the quotient is −7 and the remainder is 35, giving \(f(-2)=5(-7)+35=0\).

(c) Dividing by \((x-3)(x+2)\) gives \(3x^2+x-1\). Its discriminant is 13, so two roots are irrational.

questions.stem:
Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=3x^3\\{}+ax^2+bx+c\end{gathered}\]. Division by \(3x^2-2x+2\) leaves remainder \(-16x+22\), and division by \(x\) leaves remainder 20.

(a) Find \(a,b,c\). (b) Prove that \(x-2\) divides \(f\). (c) Are all roots rational? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=3x^3\\{}+ax^2+bx+c\end{gathered}\]。它被 \(3x^2-2x+2\) 除的餘式為 \(-16x+22\)，被 \(x\) 除的餘式為 20。

(a) 求 \(a,b,c\)。(b) 證明 \(x-2\) 是因式。(c) 各根是否全為有理數？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) The quotient has form \(x+t\). Constant terms give \(2t+22=20\), so \(t=-1\) and \(c=20\). Expanding gives \(a=-5,b=-12\).

(b) At 2 the terms sum to \(24-20-24+20=0\).

(c) Division by \(x-2\) gives \((x+2)(3x-5)\). The roots 2, −2 and \(5/3\) are rational.
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/polynomials reviews3.pdf · 第8題

questions.stem:
Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=ux^4+x^3\\{}+vx^2+wx+10\end{gathered}\]. Division by \(x+4\) and \(x-4\) leaves equal remainders. Also \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=(px^2-2x+q)\\{}\cdot (4x^2+rx+5)\end{gathered}\].

(a) Find \(p,q,r\). (b) How many positive real roots does \(f(x)=0\) have? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=ux^4+x^3\\{}+vx^2+wx+10\end{gathered}\]。被 \(x+4\) 和 \(x-4\) 除所得餘式相同。又 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=(px^2-2x+q)\\{}\cdot (4x^2+rx+5)\end{gathered}\]。

(a) 求 \(p,q,r\)。(b) 方程 \(f(x)=0\) 有多少個正實根？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) The odd terms at 4 must sum to zero. Thus \(64+4w=0\) and \(w=-16\). Constant terms give \(5q=10\), so \(q=2\). The linear coefficient gives \(2r-10=-16\), so \(r=-3\). The cubic coefficient gives \(pr-8=1\), so \(p=-3\).

(b) The first quadratic has roots of opposite signs since their product is \(-2/3\). The second has discriminant \(9-80=-71\). Hence there is one positive real root.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 在 4 處，各奇次項之和須為零，故 \(64+4w=0\)，得 \(w=-16\)。比較常數項得 \(5q=10\)，即 \(q=2\)。比較一次項得 \(2r-10=-16\)，即 \(r=-3\)。比較三次項得 \(pr-8=1\)，即 \(p=-3\)。

(b) 第一個二次因式的兩根之積為 \(-2/3\)，故一正一負。第二個因式的判別式 \(9-80=-71\)，沒有實根。故只有一個正實根。

questions.stem:
The figure shows a right circular cone of integer height \(h\) cm and slant height 10 cm. Its volume is \(96\pi\,\mathrm{cm}^3\).

(a) Prove that \(h^3-100h+288=0\). (b) Can its total surface area exceed \(100\pi\,\mathrm{cm}^2\)? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
圖中直圓錐的高為 \(h\) cm，其中 \(h\) 為整數。斜高為 10 cm，體積為 \(96\pi\,\mathrm{cm}^3\)。

(a) 證明 \(h^3-100h+288=0\)。(b) 總表面積能否大於 \(100\pi\,\mathrm{cm}^2\)？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) Let \(r\) be the base radius in cm. By Pythagoras, \(r^2=100-h^2\). The volume gives \(hr^2=288\). Substitution and rearrangement give the required cubic.

(b) Its factors are \(h-8\) and \(h^2+8h-36\). The quadratic roots \(-4\pm2\sqrt{13}\) are irrational, so the integer height is 8 and the radius is 6. Including the base gives area \(\pi(36+60)=96\pi\) square centimetres, below the threshold.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 設底半徑為 \(r\) cm。由畢氏定理得 \(r^2=100-h^2\)，由體積得 \(hr^2=288\)。代入並移項即得所證。

(b) 三次式的因式為 \(h-8\) 和 \(h^2+8h-36\)。二次式的根 \(-4\pm2\sqrt{13}\) 都是無理數，故整數高為 8，半徑為 6。計及底面，總表面積為 \(\pi(36+60)=96\pi\) 平方厘米，故不能超過題設數值。

questions.stem:
The figure shows \(y=x^2+14x+54\). Point \(B\) moves on the graph, and \(A\) is its perpendicular projection onto the horizontal axis.

(a) Given \(A=(a,0)\), express the area of triangle \(OAB\) in terms of \(a\). (b) How many positions of \(A\) give area 24? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
圖中拋物線為 \(y=x^2+14x+54\)。動點 \(B\) 在曲線上，\(A\) 是從 \(B\) 向橫軸作垂線的垂足。

(a) 設 \(A=(a,0)\)，以 \(a\) 表示三角形 \(OAB\) 的面積。(b) 面積為 24 時，\(A\) 有多少個可能位置？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) The height \((a+7)^2+5\) is positive, and the base length is \(|a|\). The area is \(|a|(a^2+14a+54)/2\).

(b) To the left of the origin, factor the area equation as \((a+8)(a^2+6a+6)=0\). This gives three negative values, \(-8\) and \(-3\pm\sqrt3\). To the right, solve \(a^3+14a^2+54a=48\). The left side strictly increases for positive \(a\) and goes from 0 to 69 between 0 and 1, giving one more position. Thus the full graph gives four positions. Restricting the point to the left as drawn gives three.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 高 \((a+7)^2+5\) 必為正數，底長為 \(|a|\)。面積為 \(|a|(a^2+14a+54)/2\)。

(b) 在原點左方，面積方程可分解為 \((a+8)(a^2+6a+6)=0\)，有三個負解 \(-8\) 和 \(-3\pm\sqrt3\)。在右方，方程為 \(a^3+14a^2+54a=48\)。左方在正數範圍嚴格遞增，且由 0 至 1 時其值由 0 增至 69，故另有一解。全條曲線共有四個位置；若只考慮圖示原點左方，則有三個。

(b) To the left of the origin, factor the area equation as \((a+8)(a^2+6a+6)=0\). This gives three negative values, \(-8\) and \(-3\pm\sqrt3\). To the right, solve \(a^3+14a^2+54a=48\). The left side strictly increases for positive \(a\) and goes from 0 to 69 between 0 and 1, giving one more position. Thus the full graph gives four positions. Restricting the point to the left as drawn gives three.

zh-Hant.text: (b) 在原點左方，面積方程可分解為 \((a+8)(a^2+6a+6)=0\)，有三個負解 \(-8\) 和 \(-3\pm\sqrt3\)。在右方，方程為 \(a^3+14a^2+54a=48\)。左方在正數範圍嚴格遞增，且由 0 至 1 時其值由 0 增至 69，故另有一解。全條曲線共有四個位置；若只考慮圖示原點左方，則有三個。

questions.stem: When \(3x^3-(k+6)x^2-x+k\) is divided by \(3x-k\), the quotient is \(x^2-2x+3\) and the remainder is \(4k\). Find \(k\).
questions.solution: Compare the coefficients of \(x\) in the division identity. The product contributes \(9+2k\). Thus \(9+2k=-1\) and \(k=-5\).
questions.solutionZh: 比較除法恆等式中 \(x\) 的係數。乘積的一次項係數為 \(9+2k\)，故 \(9+2k=-1\)，得 \(k=-5\)。

questions.stem: Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=2x^3+ax^2\\{}+bx-6\end{gathered}\]. Given \(f(2)=f(-1)=0\), choose the factorisation of \(f\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=2x^3+ax^2\\{}+bx-6\end{gathered}\]。已知 \(f(2)=f(-1)=0\)，選出其因式分解。
questions.solution: The known factors are \(x+1\) and \(x-2\). The remaining factor starts with \(2x\) and its constant term must be 3 to give −6.
questions.solutionZh: 已知因式為 \(x+1\) 和 \(x-2\)。另一因式的首項是 \(2x\)，常數項須為 3，方可使原式的常數項為 −6。

questions.stem: Let \(f=x^3-x\). The HCF of \(f,g\) is \(x+1\) and their LCM is \(x(x-3)(x^2-1)\). Which expression is \(g\)?
questions.stemZh: 設 \(f=x^3-x\)。已知 \(f,g\) 的最大公因式為 \(x+1\)，最小公倍式為 \(x(x-3)(x^2-1)\)。選出 \(g\)。
questions.solution: For the monic choices, multiply the HCF by the LCM and divide by \(f=x(x^2-1)\). This leaves \((x+1)(x-3)\).
questions.solutionZh: 所列各式的首項係數都是 1。把最大公因式乘以最小公倍式，再除以 \(f=x(x^2-1)\)，得 \((x+1)(x-3)\)。

questions.stem: Three monomials have HCF \(a^3b^2c\) and LCM \(a^4b^5c^3\). Two are \(a^3b^4c\) and \(a^3b^5c^2\). Find the third.
questions.stemZh: 三個單項式的最大公因式為 \(a^3b^2c\)，最小公倍式為 \(a^4b^5c^3\)。其中兩式為 \(a^3b^4c\) 和 \(a^3b^5c^2\)。求第三式。
questions.solution: The third monomial must supply the missing maximum exponent 4 for \(a\), minimum exponent 2 for \(b\), and maximum exponent 3 for \(c\).
questions.solutionZh: 第三式須提供尚欠的指數，即 \(a\) 的最高指數 4、\(b\) 的最低指數 2，以及 \(c\) 的最高指數 3。

questions.stem: The remainder when a polynomial \(f(x)\) is divided by \(4x-6\) is \(8\). Find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(3-2x\).
questions.stemZh: 多項式 \(f(x)\) 被 \(4x-6\) 除時餘式為 \(8\)。求 \(f(x)\) 被 \(3-2x\) 除時的餘式。
questions.solution: Both \(4x-6=0\) and \(3-2x=0\) give \(x=\frac{3}{2}\). The divisors share the same root, so both remainders equal \(f(\frac{3}{2})=8\).
questions.solutionZh: \(4x-6=0\) 與 \(3-2x=0\) 都給 \(x=\frac{3}{2}\)。兩個除式有同一個 root，所以餘式同為 \(f(\frac{3}{2})=8\)。。

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)=3x^2-kx-2\), where \(k\) is a constant. If \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(3x+1\), find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x-k\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \(f(x)=3x^2-kx-2\)，其中 \(k\) 為常數。若 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(3x+1\) 整除，求 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x-k\) 除時的餘式。
questions.solution: The factor \(3x+1\) gives \(x=-\frac{1}{3}\): \[ f\left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)=\frac{1}{3}+\frac{k}{3}-2=0, \] so \(k=5\). The required remainder is \(f(5)=48\).

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)=x^2-hx+k\), where \(h\) and \(k\) are constants. If \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(2x-h\), find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(2x+h\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \(f(x)=x^2-hx+k\)，其中 \(h,k\) 為常數。若 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(2x-h\) 整除，求 \(f(x)\) 被 \(2x+h\) 除時的餘式。
questions.solution: Since \(2x-h\) is a factor, \(f(\frac h2)=0\), giving \(k=\frac{h^2}{4}\). The root of \(2x+h\) is \(-\frac h2\), hence \[ f\left(-\frac h2\right)=\frac{h^2}{4}+\frac{h^2}{2}+\frac{h^2}{4}=h^2. \]
questions.solutionZh: \(2x-h\) 是因式，故 \(f(\frac h2)=0\)，所以 \[ \frac{h^2}{4}-\frac{h^2}{2}+k=0\Rightarrow k=\frac{h^2}{4}. \] 除式 \(2x+h\) 的 root 是 \(-\frac h2\)，故 \[ f\left(-\frac h2\right)=\frac{h^2}{4}+\frac{h^2}{2}+\frac{h^2}{4}=h^2. \] 。
